title: Common Optimal Supports and Bottleneck Hierarchies in Truncated Cones
summary: {Let \(K\subseteq\mathbb R_+^E\) be a closed convex cone and \(P=K\cap[0,1]^E\). For a linear objective with positive optimum, we study the intersection of the coordinate supports of all optimal solutions.} We prove that this common support is a transversal of a natural clutter associated with the positive directions of the cone and introduce a decreasing hierarchy of bottleneck families that stabilizes after at most \(|E|-1\) levels.
